info.title: DomainKit - DNS, SSL, WHOIS & Website Tech Lookup
info.description:
# DomainKit: DNS, SSL, WHOIS and Website Tech Lookup

Everything you want to know about a domain in four calls: live DNS records with SPF/DMARC, the TLS certificate and its expiry, registration data and domain age, and the technologies and security headers of its website.

**Who it's for:** security teams, SEO and marketing tools, sales-intelligence products, hosting dashboards and fraud teams.

## Use cases
- Alert before SSL certificates expire using `days_remaining`.
- Score signups or leads by domain age (new domains are riskier).
- Audit SPF and DMARC before sending email on a customer's behalf.
- Identify a prospect's CMS, framework and analytics stack for sales outreach.
- Grade a site's security headers in a pentest or compliance report.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://domainkit-dns-ssl-whois-website-tech-lookup.p.rapidapi.com/ssl?domain=github.com' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: domainkit-dns-ssl-whois-website-tech-lookup.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`domainkit-dns-ssl-whois-website-tech-lookup.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- All lookups are live; nothing is cached, so results reflect the moment of the request.
- The `domain` parameter accepts bare domains or full URLs; subdomains work for /dns, /ssl and /scan.
- WHOIS uses the IANA RDAP bootstrap registry; for TLDs without RDAP it falls back to port-43 WHOIS and marks the result with `source: whois`.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `400` disallowed URL (not http/https, or a private address), `404` not found, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `502` upstream site or service failed, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Live DNS resolution, TLS handshakes and HTTPS requests made at request time.
- Registration data from the authoritative registries' RDAP services (IANA bootstrap) and WHOIS servers.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Resolves the requested record types (default A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA) and summarises email security: the SPF record, the DMARC policy and whether MX exists. Use it for domain onboarding checks, email deliverability audits and monitoring.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name such as example.com. A full URL is accepted: the scheme, path and port are stripped and the value is lower-cased.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated record types. Allowed: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, CAA (case-insensitive). Any other type returns 422.

email_security.dmarc: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=reject; pct=100; rua=mailto:dmarc@github.com; ruf=mailto:dmarc@github.com; fo=1
email_security.spf: v=spf1 ip4:192.30.252.0/22 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_netblocks.google.com include:_netblocks2.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:_spf.salesforce.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:mktomail.com include:sendgrid.net ip4:62.253.227.114 ip4:166.78.69.169 ip4:166.78.69.170 ip4:166.78.71.131 ~all

get.description: Connects to the domain on port 443 and returns certificate issuer, subject, SANs, validity dates, days until expiry, serial, TLS version and cipher. If verification fails (expired, self-signed, wrong host) you get `valid: false` with the reason instead of an error. Errors: `422` invalid or unresolvable domain, `400` private address, `502` could not connect within 6 seconds.

issuer.commonName: Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA DV E36

get.description: Returns registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, domain age in days, EPP status and name servers using the registry's RDAP service, with automatic fallback to classic WHOIS. Errors: `404` domain not registered (or TLD has no RDAP/WHOIS), `502` registry error, `503` registry is rate-limiting, retry shortly.

404.description: Domain is not registered, or its TLD has no RDAP service.

example.error: Domain not found in RDAP (unregistered or TLD without RDAP)

503.description: The registry is rate limiting lookups right now; retry in a few seconds.

example.error: Registry lookup is rate limited right now; retry in a few seconds

get.summary: Detect website tech and security headers
get.description: Fetches https://<domain> (following up to 5 redirects, 10 s timeout) and reports the redirect chain, server, generator, detected technologies (WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, React, Cloudflare, Google Analytics, Stripe and about 30 more) and which of six security headers are set, with a 0-100 score. Errors: `422` invalid or unresolvable domain, `400` private address, `502` fetch failed.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name such as example.com. A full URL is accepted: the scheme, path and port are stripped and the value is lower-cased.

200.description: Scan result (headers trimmed in this example).

post.summary: MCP server (DomainKit tools for AI agents)

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

records.description: One key per requested record type. A type with no records is an empty array. MX entries are objects sorted by priority; SOA is an object when present; TXT values are joined strings; other types are strings.

TXT.description: TXT records (SPF, verification tokens and so on).

CNAME.description: Canonical name target, if the name is an alias.

SOA.description: Start of authority (an empty array when absent).

spf.description: The v=spf1 TXT record, if TXT was requested and one exists.

dmarc.description: The DMARC policy from _dmarc.<domain> (always looked up).

has_mx.description: True if MX was requested and records exist.

SslResult.description: TLS certificate details for port 443. When the certificate fails verification only `domain`, `valid`, `error`, `protocol` and `cipher` are returned.

valid.description: Certificate chain and hostname verified against the system trust store.

error.description: Verification failure reason (only when `valid` is false), for example 'certificate has expired'.

issuer.description: Issuer distinguished-name fields such as commonName, organizationName, countryName.

san.description: DNS names in the Subject Alternative Name extension (first 50).

days_remaining.description: Whole days until expiry (negative if expired).

WhoisResult.description: Registration data from RDAP (falls back to port-43 WHOIS when the registry rate-limits RDAP).

registered.description: Always true on a 200 response (unregistered domains return 404).

created.description: Registration date as reported by the registry (ISO 8601 for RDAP).

status.description: EPP status values such as 'client transfer prohibited' (empty for WHOIS fallback).

dnssec.description: Whether the delegation is DNSSEC-signed (null if unknown).

source.description: Present and set to `whois` only when the port-43 WHOIS fallback was used.

ScanResult.description: Website technology and security-header scan of https://<domain>.

status_code.description: HTTP status of the final response.

technologies.description: Detected technologies (CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDNs, servers), alphabetical. Detection is signature-based on HTML and headers.

security_headers.description: Presence of six recommended security headers.

security_score.description: Percentage of the six security headers present (0-100).

headers.description: Response headers of the final page (lower-cased names, first 60).

BadRequest.description: Bad request: the URL is not http(s), or points to a private, loopback or reserved address.

example.error: Private or reserved addresses are not allowed

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable: a required parameter is missing or a value is invalid. The `error` text says which.

example.error: A required parameter is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider

BadGateway.description: Bad gateway: the remote site or upstream service could not be reached, timed out, or returned an error.
